About Me

Hi! I'm Reynald Abner Tananda, S.T., a Fresh Graduate in Computer Science from Universitas Hasanuddin specializing in Software Engineering and Mobile Development with a GPA of 3.80/4.00.

I have hands-on experience developing full-stack web platforms and mobile applications, including backend engineering for hospital logbook systems (RS UNHAS) and serving as a Teaching Assistant for Mobile Programming (Flutter).

As an active hobby, I enjoy participating in competitive CTF (Capture The Flag) challenges, leading the Digital Forensics division at ICC UNHAS, and sharing cybersecurity learning modules with peers.
